payload.title: Tighten the CDK execution policy (CloudFormationExecutionPolicies) for deployment accounts
payload.description: The CDK bootstrap in the Humorus account has an empty CloudFormationExecutionPolicies, so cdk-hnb659fds-cfn-exec-role has AdministratorAccess, and the app-shell pipeline deploys through it (docs/account-pipeline.md, The app shell). Define a narrower execution policy (Amplify, AppSync, Cognito, DynamoDB, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, Route 53 records, IAM limited by permissions boundary, SSM, CloudWatch, SQS, SNS, EventBridge) in the baseline and bootstrap with it; adopt the hand-made CDKToolkit stack under the pipeline. Not a blocker.
